title: Get a permit to film on council land
what: Get the council's permit before commercial filming or photography on roads, parks or other council land.

sources.title: Approval for commercial filming photography brisbane city council
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this approval if you intend to undertake commercial filming or photography on council land, including: any use of council managed assets or venues using drones in public areas all student films or photo shoots in public areas or council managed assets or venues using council managed facilities or venues for wedding photography wedding photography to promote a photography business wedding photography in parks requiring exclusive use of an area or within a bookable space.

triggers.note: it films on roads, parks or other council land

reach.condition: if it films on council land
